name: Shunlin
source:
A girl yearning for love who's training to be a daoshi under the tutelage of her grandfather, Lihong. Has had a deep respect for Lihong, but they butt heads when it comes to the topic of love.

Her pet, Mimi, is always with her.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/otomedaoshi/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
